summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release detailing its ongoing share buyback program. The second tranche of a multi-year €3.5 billion buyback, announced April 10, 2026, repurchased 44,782 shares on the Euronext Milan between April 27-30, 2026, for €13.1 million at an average price of €293.06. Total consideration since tranche start is €42.8 million for 141,819 shares. As of May 1, 2026, Ferrari held 17.6 million treasury shares (9.06% of outstanding common shares). This capital return program is part of a commitment through 2030, with no stated premium or board recommendation. Watch for ongoing execution pace and potential cancellation of shares as previously approved.
